section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Embodied Image Scale (EIS), a 17-item instrument measuring body image across six subscales with both functional and aesthetic dimensions. The EIS has demonstrated adequate internal consistency (α = .72–.90) and acceptable validity in Western samples of men and women. No study-specific data, participant demographics, or correlation results are reported in this methodological description.
